en.headline: Man dies after collapsing while hiking on Tai Mo Shan
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded after a man reported chest pain on Tai Mo Shan on Monday; he was airlifted to hospital but pronounced dead.
body: A man died after collapsing while hiking on Tai Mo Shan on Monday afternoon.

Police received a report around noon from a companion that the man had felt unwell and experienced chest pain while on the trail. Fire Services Department personnel and the Government Flying Service attended, and the man was airlifted to hospital.
He was pronounced dead despite emergency treatment. The case has been classified as a sudden death and is under investigation. No other injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 男子大帽山行山胸口痛昏迷 送院後不治
zh.dek: 周一中午一名男子在大帽山行山時胸口痛，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他送院，最終不治。
body: 一名男子周一在大帽山行山期間感到胸口痛並昏迷，送院後不治。
警方約中午接獲同行者報案，指事主在山徑上身體不適。消防處及政府飛行服務隊接報到場，將男子以直升機送往醫院接受急救。
院方其後證實事主死亡。案件列作猝死，警方正調查事件，暫未有其他受傷報告。
